decision: A qualified name, optionally followed by `::**` to import recursively, as KerML 8.2.3.4.2 states it and SysML repeats.
notes:
THE XTEXT IS NOT PORTED. The pilot rule opens with an ImportPrefix fragment that carries the visibility, `import` and `all` which the specification puts in Import itself — the manual inlining recorded on the Import unit. Here that prefix belongs to Import, and this production starts at the imported name.

The name is `[QualifiedName]`, a reference resolved later; the rule carries the QualifiedName and resolution is not concrete syntax.

`**` IS ONE TOKEN. It is in the pinned token set as the exponent operator, which is why `A::**` lexes as `A`, `::`, `**` and not as two stars.
